name: phd-defense-term-not-registered
description: DGS Handbook §8.2.5 (“Notre Dame requires students to be enrolled and registered for the term in which they defend their theses or dissertations”) and Academic Code §3.7 — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-dh-6-9-5; DGS: “Apply the suggested handling”. A Ph.D. student who defends in Spring 2030 with no Notre Dame course entered for that semester: the defense row keeps its status and points, behind Relevant Policies, to confirming the registration with the Grad Admin.

detailIncludes: No Notre Dame course is entered for Spring 2030, the semester of your defense
confirm your registration with the Grad Admin (DGS Handbook §8.2.5; Academic Code §3.7)
